sub_tasks.desc: coder Agent: Implement Firebase notification service with multi-tenant support using Firebase Admin SDK to send push notifications with encrypted payloads and implement tenant isolation by including tenant_id in notification metadata.

coder Agent: Create Firebase service account configuration storing service account JSON with restricted permissions and encrypt sensitive fields, ensuring the file is excluded from version control via .gitignore.
docker Agent: Create optimized Dockerfile for backend using multi-stage build to reduce image size below 500 MB and include only necessary dependencies and set non-root user for security.

docker Agent: Create optimized Dockerfile for frontend using lightweight Node.js base image and optimize static asset delivery, ensuring environment variables for API endpoints are configurable at runtime.

GKE Agent: Create Kubernetes deployment manifests defining resource limits, liveness probes, and environment variables for backend and frontend, including tenant_id as a configurable environment variable for multi-tenancy.

GKE Agent: Create Kubernetes service and ingress manifests configuring internal services for backend and frontend with proper port mappings and setting up HTTPS ingress with TLS termination and path-based routing for APIs and frontend.

coder Agent: Create production environment configuration defining production database URLs, Firebase settings, and encryption keys, ensuring all sensitive values are placeholderized for Kubernetes secret injection.

reviewer Agent: Perform security review on notification service validating input sanitization to prevent injection attacks in notification payloads and ensuring JWT tokens are validated for tenant scope in notification requests.

tester Agent: Write integration tests for notification service testing notification delivery with mocked Firebase responses and verifying tenant isolation, covering edge cases like invalid device tokens and network failures.

doc Agent: Create deployment and notification flow documentation detailing steps for building Docker images, deploying to GKE, and configuring ingress, including diagrams for notification flow using PlantUML or similar.
